gaps.sentence: You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.

gaps.sentence: He told me ___ touch that switch.
I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: She's very good ___ explaining difficult ideas.
The project ran ___ of money halfway through.
gaps.explanation: 'Run out of' = use up the supply.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).
